entities.name: PMID:25089018
observations: In oleic-acid-induced steatotic primary hepatocytes, sophocarpine reduced TLR4 expression and pro-inflammatory cytokine synthesis; NF-κB, JNK, and ERK activation were restrained, and TLR4/cytokine measures recovered after drug removal.

entities.name: Sophocarpine
observations: In vitro, reduced TLR4 expression and pro-inflammatory cytokine synthesis in oleic-acid-steatotic primary hepatocytes.

entities.name: HGNC:11850
observations: TLR4 expression was increased in oleic-acid-induced steatotic primary hepatocytes and reduced by sophocarpine.

entities.name: Sophocarpine-TLR4 steatosis finding
observations: An in-vitro primary-hepatocyte study reported that sophocarpine lowered TLR4 expression and cytokine synthesis in oleic-acid-induced steatosis while restraining NF-κB, JNK, and ERK signaling; outcomes rebounded after washout.
